original_prompt: Edit this exact wardrobe catalog image. Remove flesh and anatomy inside sheer tights, hollow fabric only. Preserve all garment design, colors, arrangement and white background. No skin, toes, hands, human body, mannequin or anatomy anywhere. Empty shoes with clearly visible empty interior footbeds; white background through any openings. Hollow garments only. Do not introduce accessories or change clothing.
